page_description: Bring saved Wallabag articles to your Kobo, then archive or favorite them as you read.
release_notes: Every saved article stays reachable at all text sizes. Back keeps your list page, late sign-in refreshes respect navigation, and overlapping syncs preserve other tabs.

steps.text: Create an API client on your Wallabag server (on wallabag.it: Settings, API clients).
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Sign Read Later in. The password is read from KOBO_WALLABAG_PASSWORD, never the command line.
steps.command: kobo readlater login --server https://app.wallabag.it --client-id ID --client-secret-file secret.txt --username you@example.com
